NOVVES; processes personal data in accordance with the law and the rules of honesty, accurately and, when necessary, up to date, in line with specific, clear and legitimate purposes, in connection with the purpose for which they are processed, in a limited and measured manner. Personal data are retained for the period stipulated in the relevant legislation or necessary for the purpose for which they are processed.

This policy is the main umbrella text explaining NOVVES' general privacy and personal data protection approach. Special texts or forms may also be published for website visitors, cookie usage, customer and partner processes, product security contact point and contact person applications.

sections.title: LEGAL REASONS FOR PROCESSING PERSONAL DATA

blocks.text: Your personal data may be processed based on the following legal reasons specified in the relevant legislation, especially Articles 5 and 6 of the KVKK:

items: It is clearly provided for in the law
Processing of personal data is necessary for the establishment or performance of a contract
Data processing is mandatory for our company to fulfill its legal obligations
Data processing is mandatory for the establishment, exercise or protection of a right
Data processing is mandatory for the legitimate interests of our Company, provided that it does not harm your fundamental rights and freedoms.
It has been made public by the person concerned
Having your explicit consent

blocks.text: personal data in respect of persons within the scope of the European Economic Area, the European Union or the GDPR; It is processed in accordance with legal bases such as performance of the contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest, explicit consent, public interest and vital interest.

blocks.text: Your personal data is transferred only to the extent necessary and in accordance with the relevant legal conditions.

NOVVES can work with customers, suppliers, representatives, business partners and digital service providers operating on a global scale. sections.title: RIGHTS OF RELATED PERSONS IN TURKEY UNDER KVKK

blocks.text: In accordance with Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the following rights as a personal data owner:

items: Learning whether your personal data is being processed or not
Requesting information if your personal data has been processed
Learning the purpose of processing your personal data and whether it is used in accordance with its purpose
Knowing the third parties to whom your personal data is transferred domestically or abroad
Request correction of your personal data if it is incomplete or incorrectly processed
Requesting the deletion or destruction of your personal data within the framework of the conditions stipulated in KVKK
Requesting correction, deletion or destruction to be notified to third parties to whom your personal data has been transferred
Object to the emergence of a result against you by analyzing the processed data exclusively through automatic systems
Request compensation for the damage if you suffer damage due to unlawful processing of your personal data.

sections.title: RIGHTS OF PERSONS WITHIN THE EUROPEAN UNION / EUROPEAN ECONOMIC AREA

blocks.text: Persons covered by the GDPR may have the following rights, as far as applicable:

items: Right to access personal data
Right to request correction of personal data
Right to request deletion of personal data
Right to request restriction of processing
Right to data portability
Right to object to processing based on legitimate interest
The right to withdraw consent in processing activities based on explicit consent
Right to object to automated decision-making and profiling
Right to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority

sections.title: PRIVACY RIGHTS FOR USERS LOCATED IN THE USA

blocks.text: In the United States, data protection legislation may differ on a state-by-state basis. If applicable, particularly under regulations such as the California Consumer Privacy Act / California Privacy Rights Act, users may have the following rights:

items: Learn what personal information is collected
Request access to personal information
Request deletion of personal information
Request correction of inaccurate information
The right to opt out of certain data sharing or sales
Request restriction of use of sensitive personal information
The right not to be discriminated against for exercising privacy rights

blocks.text: NOVVES does not adopt selling personal data as a core business model. However, since the use of digital advertising, analytics or third-party cookies may be considered within the scope of "sharing", "targeted advertising" or similar concepts according to the relevant legislation, these transactions are also managed by cookie preferences and open consent mechanisms.

NOVVES does not analyze your personal data exclusively through automatic systems and processes it for the purpose of making decisions that will have legal consequences against you or have a similarly significant impact.

In case of limited analysis such as website usage statistics, cookies, marketing preferences or customer segmentation, these processes are carried out in accordance with the relevant legislation and, where necessary, with explicit consent or preference management mechanisms.

NOVVES' products and services are aimed primarily at commercial, industrial and professional users. NOVVES does not knowingly collect personal data of children or conduct marketing activities towards children.

If it is determined that children's personal data have been processed inadvertently, the necessary deletion, destruction or anonymization processes are applied in accordance with the relevant legislation.
The NOVVES website may contain links to third-party websites, social media platforms, document download areas or external digital services.

NOVVES is not responsible for the privacy practices, content or data processing activities of third party sites. You are advised to review the privacy policies of the relevant third parties before visiting these sites.

blocks.text: As NOVVES ELEKTRİK MOTOR ANONİM ŞİRKETİ (“NOVVES”, “Company”, “we”); We attach importance to the use of our products in a safe, accurate, standard-compliant and evaluated manner according to project conditions.

This Product Safety and Technical Support Contact Point; It was created to receive product safety notifications, technical support requests, nonconformity notifications, certificate and documentation requests, service and warranty applications regarding NOVVES products through the correct channels, evaluate them and direct them to the relevant units.

This page; It is a contact point for customers, potential customers, dealers, representatives, distributors, mechanical installation companies, project designers, consultants, contractors, end users, maintenance teams, authorized services and public institutions.

blocks.text: This contact point has been created for the safe use and technical evaluation of NOVVES products. In emergency life safety, fire, electric shock, serious injury or similar dangerous situations, the relevant emergency teams, facility security teams, fire brigade, occupational health and safety units or authorized public institutions should be contacted first.

sections.title: IN WHAT CASES SHOULD NOTIFICATION BE MADE?

blocks.text: You can contact us in the following situations regarding NOVVES products:

items: Detection of a risky situation that may affect the safe operation of the product
Observation of an electrical, mechanical, thermal or structural nonconformity
Abnormal sounds, vibrations, temperatures, odors, smoke, rubbing or operating irregularities
There is a safety doubt regarding the motor, fan, propeller, body, bearing, fastener or control system.
Suspicion of error in the product label, model information, serial number or technical documentation
There is a need for verification of a certificate, declaration of conformity, performance document or technical data
There is a need for technical evaluation regarding the suitability of the product for the project conditions, usage environment or application purpose.
Encountering a problem that may affect safety during installation, commissioning, maintenance or service
Requesting warranty, service, spare parts or maintenance support
Want to submit feedback, suggestions or complaints regarding the safe use of the product in the field

blocks.text: In order for your product safety or technical support notification to be evaluated quickly and accurately, it is recommended that you share the following information, if possible:

items: Name and surname
Company name
Position/title
phone number
Email address
Country/city
Project name
Product model
Product serial number
Order or quote number
Product photos
label photo
Installation location and usage area
Working conditions of the product
Description of malfunction, risk or non-conformity
Date and time of the incident
Maintenance, service or commissioning records, if any
Video, report, measurement result or technical document, if any
emergency situation
Type of support requested

blocks.text: If there is missing information, NOVVES may request additional information or documents in order to evaluate the notification.
You can submit your product safety, technical support and documentation requests through the following channels:
E-posta: info@novves.com
KEP: novveselektrik@hs01.kep.tr
Postal Address: Taşköprü Merkez Mah. Çaydere St. No:9/1 İç Kapı No:2 Çiftlikköy / YALOVA
Website: www.novves.com
If there is a product safety or technical support form on the website, you can also submit your requests via the relevant form.
It is recommended to use the KEP address for official notifications, legal applications or authorized institution correspondence.
Product safety and technical support notifications submitted to NOVVES are evaluated by the relevant units according to the nature of the notification.
The evaluation process may include the following steps:

items: Receiving notification
Classification of notification subject
Review of product model, serial number and technical information
Evaluation of photos, videos, service records or measurement results
Requesting additional information or documents if necessary
Reviewing with the technical team, quality unit, production, engineering or after-sales support units
If necessary, field inspection, remote technical interview or service guidance.
Notifying the relevant person of the technical evaluation result
Initiating corrective or preventive actions when necessary
Evaluation of required official notifications within the scope of applicable legislation

blocks.text: NOVVES evaluates each notification on its own terms. Notification alone does not mean that the product defect is accepted, that action will be taken under warranty, or that legal liability is assumed.

In case of serious life safety risk, fire risk, electrical danger, mechanical rupture risk, smoke evacuation system safety, occupational health and safety risk or similar emergency situations related to the product, the notification subject should be clearly stated as "Emergency Product Safety Notification".
The following information should especially be shared in emergency situations:

items: Type of risk
Whether the product is in use or not
Location of the product
Whether the event occurred or not
Whether there is any injury, fire, smoke, electrical malfunction or material damage.
Whether the product has been discontinued
Whether facility officials or emergency teams were informed

blocks.text: In situations requiring life safety or emergency intervention, relevant emergency teams and authorized institutions should be contacted before or simultaneously before notifying NOVVES.
The following documents regarding NOVVES products can be requested:

items: technical catalog
Product data sheet
Use and care instruction
Assembly instruction
Commissioning information
Declaration of conformity
Declaration of performance
Certificate information
Test report information
Product label verification information
Technical description specific to the project or product

blocks.text: Document requests must be submitted by specifying the relevant product model, serial number, project name and intended use.

Certificate, test report and conformity documents; It should be evaluated only in terms of the relevant product, model, series, production period, application area and certification scope. It should not be assumed that every product is automatically suitable for every project, country or usage condition.

NOVVES products; It may be subject to different technical standards, legislation, certification processes and conformity assessments depending on the product type, intended use, project requirements and target market.

The following issues should be separately evaluated on a project-specific basis in terms of smoke and heat extraction fans, axial fans, jet fans, motors, automation panels, ventilation equipment and related products:

items: Product model
Intended use
Ambient conditions
temperature resistance
Flow rate and pressure requirement
Electrical properties
Fire safety requirements
Certificate scope
Mounting method
maintenance access
Local legislation
Project specification
Authorized institution or consultant approvals

blocks.text: Standard references on the website, in catalogs or technical documents are general information. For exact technical suitability, NOVVES's written technical evaluation and project-specific conditions must be taken into account.
In order to ensure product safety, customers, applicators, installation teams, maintenance teams and end users should pay attention to the following:

items: Use the product only for its intended use
Have the installation done by authorized and technically qualified people.
Making electrical connections in accordance with relevant standards and instructions
Operating the product within the limits specified in the catalog and operating instructions
Carrying out maintenance and cleaning operations regularly
Not making unauthorized changes, interventions or modifications to the product
Not using non-original or unverified parts
Keeping the product label, serial number and technical documentation
Safely stop the product in case of abnormal operation, noise, vibration, heating or safety risk
Reporting situations that may affect product safety to NOVVES without delay
Acting in accordance with local legislation, occupational health and safety rules and project specifications

blocks.text: Incorrect installation, misuse, unauthorized intervention, improper operating conditions or lack of maintenance of the product may affect product safety.
Product safety notices may be linked to warranty or service claims. However, making a product safety notification does not automatically mean that the notification is accepted under warranty.
The following factors may be taken into account in warranty and service evaluations:

items: Product model and serial number
Sale or delivery date
Terms of use
Mounting conditions
Commissioning information
maintenance history
Whether there is user intervention
working environment
Whether there is any physical damage or modification on the product
Relevant contract, offer or warranty terms

blocks.text: If deemed necessary, NOVVES may inspect the product on-site, perform a remote technical evaluation or direct authorized service.

sections.title: MARKET SUPERVISION AND COOPERATION WITH AUTHORIZED INSTITUTIONS

blocks.text: NOVVES may cooperate with competent public institutions, market surveillance and control authorities, certification bodies, testing laboratories and relevant technical authorities in accordance with the applicable legislation within the scope of product safety and technical regulations.

If a serious risk affecting product safety is detected, NOVVES may evaluate the necessary corrective or preventive actions in line with the relevant legislation, contractual obligations and technical evaluation results.
These activities may include the following, depending on the nature of the situation:

items: Additional technical review
User information
Service forwarding
Technical documentation update
Instruction for use or maintenance notice
Product improvement work
Part replacement
Control on the field
Communication with authorized institutions when necessary

blocks.text: Personal data you submit to us within the scope of product security and technical support notifications; It may be processed for the purposes of receiving and evaluating the notification, communicating with you, performing technical analysis, carrying out the service process, providing documentation, fulfilling legal obligations and communicating with authorized institutions when necessary.
Personal data that can be processed in this context are:

items: Name and surname
Company name
Position/title
phone number
Email address
Address or location information
Request and notification content
Product and project information
Technical support and service records
Photos, videos, reports and additional documents

blocks.text: For detailed information regarding the processing of personal data, NOVVES's "Personal Data Protection and Privacy Policy", "Customer Information Text" and other relevant information texts should be examined.

sections.title: CONFIDENTIALITY AND PROTECTION OF TECHNICAL INFORMATION

blocks.text: Project information, technical documents, product photographs, application details, field reports and similar information submitted to NOVVES are used for the purpose of evaluating the notification.

NOVVES may share this information with relevant internal units, technical teams, service stakeholders, suppliers, testing and certification organizations or authorized institutions to the extent required by the business.

If trade secrets, project information, technical drawings or confidential information documents are shared, the user accepts that he/she has the necessary authorizations and that the shared information may be used by NOVVES for notification evaluation purposes.

Product safety and technical support requests can be submitted in Turkish or English. In international projects, providing support in different languages ​​depending on the nature of the request depends on the evaluation of NOVVES.

NOVVES's written responses are taken as basis for technical evaluation, certificate verification and official correspondence. Verbal discussions alone do not constitute binding technical approval or formal commitment.
Notifications made with incomplete, inaccurate, misleading or unverifiable information may delay the technical evaluation process or prevent a sound evaluation.
NOVVES reserves its legal rights regarding notifications that are malicious, misleading, damaging to commercial reputation, or in violation of competition law or intellectual property rights.
This contact point has been created to receive security, technical support, documentation and nonconformity notifications regarding NOVVES products.

The information on this page is general information. This information; It does not replace engineering calculations, project design, fire safety consultancy, occupational health and safety assessment, official institution approval or technical specification approval.

NOVVES evaluates each notification within its own technical, commercial, legal and regulatory conditions. Notification does not mean that NOVVES accepts fault, liability, warranty coverage or compensation liability.
